brief: Reads items out of a list without changing it: by position, first or last, in sections, at random, by type, or in neighbouring runs.
detail: It is the reading helper of stzList, which builds one over itself for its UniqueItems, EveryNthItem, Head, Tail and ItemsBetween methods; build one with new stzListGetter when you only need to read. It works on its own copy, so a stzList passed in is never changed. Positions count from 1. NthItem, NFirstItems, NLastItems, Head, Tail and ItemsAtPositions raise error R2 when a position or a count goes past the list, while Section forgives it by clipping to the list and Range cuts a run that is too long. The Q forms (NFirstItemsQ, PairsQ, SlidingWindowQ ...) return the answer as a stzList to chain on. UniqueItemsCS takes the case flag (0 folds a and A). OnlyChars misses a single non-ASCII character today, and RandomItem and NRandomItems answer differently on every call.
